title: The Consequences of Making the Wrong Friends
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On January 19, 2023, police encountered a stolen white Ford Fusion in Glendale, WI. When a traffic stop was attempted, the 20-year-old driver began fleeing and stop sticks were quickly deployed. Eventually, the suspect vehicle came to a stop and four males fled on foot. It was later discovered three of the males were teens, with one of them having two felony juvenile warrants.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
